richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the bonding strength of the wheelchair ramp to hinge plate may not meet requirements. A de-bonded ramp could collapse without warning while in use.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect wheelchair ramp and replace as necessary.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the hand pole fixing bracket/casting at the celling may fracture and break free resulting in the potential risk of passenger fall and injury when using the hand pole.
richiami.rimedio: Remedy is to replace the current hand pole casting with the previous design casting which can handle more force.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the C Clamp supporting the anti-roll bar may deform and shear at the upper mounting face resulting in increased body roll.
richiami.rimedio: Replace Anti-roll bar C clamps with redesigned clamp.
richiami.titolo: Anti Roll Bar C Clamp Crack

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the GRP roof panels / POD may detach during adverse weather conditions. If the GRP roof pod detaches this may cause harm to pedestrians and other road users.
richiami.modello: M2900 EV Solo , M2900 EV Solo
richiami.rimedio: Remedy is to inspect roof panels in area of fixing screws and re-bond panels as required.
